 Serie A - Game Week 11 7 Nov 2026 - 12:00 Stadio Ennio Tardini DAZN has exclusive rights to Parma v Bologna. You'll need a subscription to watch on a smart TV, smartphone, tablet or computer. Customers with both DAZN and Sky subscriptions can also watch on DAZN 1, available on satellite channel 214.
 At the Tardini in Parma, Parma host Bologna in a derby on matchday 11 of Serie A 2026/27. Both sides arrive on the back of wins in the previous round.
 Alberto Gilardino's Parma beat Atalanta 3-0 in Bergamo for a historic away victory. The result lifted them out of the relegation zone and took them to eight points.
 Simone Lontani stole the show in Bergamo. Born in 2008, the striker has already scored five goals this season. The former AC Milan youngster scored Parma's third, putting the ball through Pasalic's legs before guiding a precise right-footed shot into Carnesecchi's bottom corner.
 Meanwhile, Raffaele Palladino's Bologna have won three in a row, most recently beating Monza 2-1. They have stepped up a gear since Palladino replaced Domenico Tedesco as manager and will look to keep that run going.
 Parma want to build on Gilardino's first win as their manager and strengthen their position in the table. Bologna are chasing a fourth straight victory as they look to consolidate theirs.

 Gilardino is expected to stick with much of the starting XI that beat Atalanta. Daffara is likely to start in goal, with Delprato, N'Diaye and Troilo in defence, and Britschgi, Fabbian, Sierro, Keita and Valeri in midfield. Lontani is set to start up front again, while Romero and Touré are competing for a place. Drobnic and Bernabé are out.
 For Bologna, Palladino is expected to start Skorupski in goal behind a back three of Casale, Darmian and Theate. Miranda, Amondarain, Ferguson and Pobega are likely to play in midfield, with Bernardeschi and Cambiaghi supporting centre-forward Odgaard. He has been called upon to replace the injured Piccoli. Holm, Enem and De Silvestri are unavailable.
